payload.reason: The evidence discusses the evaluation of stopping methods in the context of text classification, specifically using batch sizes and the Oracle Method for performance assessment.

claims.text: The downstream tasks evaluated include the effect of batch size on active learning stopping methods for text classification.
The Oracle Method is used to contextualize stopping results, which is a downstream task evaluated in the study.
Batch sizes of 1%, 5%, and 10% of the training data are specifically evaluated in the experiments.
